why: Proposal A forms a cohesive, light, warm-neutral scheme: a plain beige rug, a white TV console that blends with the walls, an orange cushion that adds the requested color, and curtains that suit the sliding door. Proposal B's bold black-and-white geometric rug, dark walnut chevron cabinet (which clashes with the light wood table and the grey floor) and busy patterned pillows compete with each other and make the room feel heavier and less bright.
